incidentalFinding.what: so-ui.mts memory-queue reconfirm --index 0 could not click anything: the selector used CSS :nth-of-type(N), which counts among SIBLINGS OF THE SAME TAG — the panel's quarantined rows are divs alongside the header and the conflict rows, so it selected the panel's own first div and matched nothing, failing exactly like an empty queue.
incidentalFinding.whyItWasNotSeen: the probe's click path had never been driven against the live DOM (its own record said so), and the unit test pinned the selector STRING, which is not a DOM.
incidentalFinding.fix: scripts/debug/so-ui.mts now uses Playwright's nth= engine on the container (0-based), the same shape the pair actions already used; the selector unit test updated.
incidentalFinding.proof: j6-panel-reconfirm.json — selector '[data-so="quarantined"] >> nth=0 >> [data-so="reconfirm"]', matched 1, clicked, store quarantined 0 afterwards
